capabilities: Paginate Markdown notes into card pages using heading and list structure
Build covers from content-type templates with custom images, text, and colors
Drag and reposition title, subtitle, tag, and badge modules on covers
Export the current page or all pages as high-resolution PNGs
Save layout parameters back to the note's properties
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Rendering and PNG generation run locally, but previewing or exporting notes that reference remote images may send requests to the image's original address.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn existing notes into styled, paginated social-media image cards ready for posting.

relations.evidence: XHS Cards turns Markdown notes into Xiaohongshu covers and multi-page image cards.

summary: Markdown-to-image studio that lays Obsidian notes out as Xiaohongshu cover and multi-page cards and exports them as high-resolution PNGs.
